sources.notes: Official per-stage KMZ files uploaded by the ACM on 2025-12-18/19 as attachments of the spectator maps page (found via acm.mc WP REST media API). Each KMZ has one LineString plus Points TC / START / FINISH / STOP and ZP (public zone) points; only START/FINISH used. The LineStrings run TC -> STOP (include approach and stop zone), so trim to START..FINISH for display. Along-line START->FINISH lengths (nearest vertex) vs official km: SS1 22.31/21.90, SS2 24.03/23.80, SS3/11 15.21/15.06, SS4/7 18.10/17.95, SS5/8 28.93/28.70, SS6/9 17.95/17.79, SS10/12 30.11/29.93, SS14/16 12.81/12.50, SS15/17 23.93/23.45 (lines ~1-2% longer, normal digitising noise); SSS13 is a loop on the Monaco circuit (line 2.99 km incl. TC/stop, official 2.69). All locations match stage names geographically. Match by file name = stage numbers (certain). Shakedown (not in stages list): SHAKEDOWN.kmz 'START SD' 44.560021,6.042557 / 'FINISH SD' 44.559855,6.017924 (line 'SD', START->FINISH 4.26 km vs 4.25 official). Ignored: SS2.kmz and SS2-copie.kmz (uploaded 2025-12-18) contain a different 'SS 2' (TC near 44.3976,6.0906, ~21.1 km) that does not match SS2 Esclangon/Seyne-les-Alpes of the 2026 WRC itinerary - probably another event/draft.
sources.verification: Re-checked 2026-10-21 against the itinerary (RP Annexe 1, Version 1 19.11.2025): lines are cut at the projections of the official START/FINISH placemarks and measured on WGS84. SS1 +1.96%, SS2 +0.97%, SS3/11 +1.26%, SS4/7 +0.95%, SS5/8 +0.94%, SS6/9 +1.01%, SS10/12 +0.53% (drawn). SS13 (2 laps, START->FINISH along the line 2.79 vs 2.69 km), SS14/16 (12.81 vs 12.50) and SS15/17 (23.97 vs 23.45) exceed 2% and are shown as start/finish only. Service park: RP art. 2.8 gives COSEC 44°32'24.8"N 6°03'39.7"E (30 m from the OSM point).
